summary: Client: telecommunications provider in Japan. Moved to HCLTech with HPE's Communications Technology Group on its acquisition; same client and team.
responsibilities: Built a Python batch job that cross-references MySQL billing data with LDAP subscriber records to export unpaid accounts eligible for cancellation, with duplicate-run protection and unit tests.
Maintained and extended the billing reconciliation system through multiple production bug-fix releases.
Built, from a requirements document, a Perl toolkit for bulk LDAP updates: LDIF generation, bcrypt password hashing and rollback templates (rollback tested on a test server). Used in production.
Adapted a Perl SMTP abuse-detection engine for a second telecom client.
Enhanced a Python spam-digest email service with configurable templates and encoding fixes.

summary: Communications Technology Group. Client: telecommunications provider in Japan.

Connected each page to the backend APIs, implemented client-side form validation, and displayed the backend's rejection messages.
Fixed layout and error-handling bugs in an Angular 8 operations portal (PrimeNG, Bootstrap, SCSS).

Began implementing, from requirement documents, clustered mail storage support in a Perl mail account migration tool across data centers, adapting to changing requirements. Carried through to production after the move to HCLTech.
Customised an existing enterprise portal product for a major Malaysian telecommunications provider to meet the client's requirements, working from user stories.

Set up Azure AD login for the application, serving two user roles (account managers and dealers).
Added, updated and removed code in an Express (Node.js) layer that sits between external APIs and the product and reshapes the data to fit the product.
Set up the application in the environment used by the performance testing team.
Fixed vulnerabilities reported by the security team's testing, and wrote reusable code to ease future maintenance.
Supported the client through UAT and PVT on site, and supported the production deployment, including out-of-hours.

Built the front end of two new modules from scratch for an HR software product, using Vue.js: Learning (course-based learning) and E-Travel (submission of travel documentation), in response to requests from multiple clients.
Fixed front-end bugs from a Jira backlog to keep the live system running.
Merged code and deployed releases and hotfixes from staging to live using Git.
Maintained an existing web application and built new React components for a redesigned interface.
Converted legacy jQuery code to React as part of the interface redesign.
Maintained the front end of an online travel platform that connects travellers with local travel experts to build customised itineraries, and built new reusable React components.
Used Linux and Docker for local development.
